messages:
marie_cs: Quick pulse — QBR for AtlasPay in 3 days. Need final slide polish + actions. What are current onboarding blockers + renewal flags?
aj_sales: Heads-up: finance had a billing question, not solved; renewal confidence ~70%. I'll escalate.
lina_csm: Onboarding: SSO delay (customer security), two data connectors failing, demo env flaky. Working w/eng.
sam_eng: Looking at connector logs now, root cause looks like schema mismatch. I can patch tonight.
marie_cs: Good — can you add a one-line ETA to the 'Onboarding blockers' slide? Keep it concise.
sam_eng: Will do. ETA 21:00 PT.
rafael_enable: I'll own the 'Enablement & Training' slide — capture feedback from last session: attendees confused by RBAC flow and need example walkthroughs.
lina_csm: Add note: customer requested hands-on lab; recommend 1-hr workshop before QBR.
aj_sales: Ask from leadership: show cost delta dedicated vs hosted in one slide; who can pull that?
marie_cs: @sam_eng or @lina_csm can you grab a short cost delta table? simple numbers fine.
lina_csm: I'll pull billing dashboard numbers and paste into the deck.
ops_bot: Reminder: dry-run scheduled in ~24h.
marie_cs: Confirm dry-run — Fri 10:30am PT (1765562000). Everyone who owns slides pls be ready.
sam_eng: Confirmed. I'll have the connector note and patch link.
rafael_enable: Confirmed. I'll bring the workshop outline and attendee list.
aj_sales: Renewal risk update: finance approval blocked by legal on data residency. Risk = elevated. Need someone to surface this to legal.
lina_csm: I'll loop in our legal contact and cc @aj_sales.
marie_cs: Action-tags (please react with :white_check_mark: when done):
- A1: sam_eng -> 'Connector fix' + slide bullet + ETA (due 1765560000)
- A2: lina_csm -> 'Billing + cost delta' slide + legal intro (due 1765561000)
- A3: rafael_enable -> 'Enablement workshop outline' slide + attendee list (due 1765560500)
- A4: aj_sales -> 'Renewal negotiation points' doc for leadership (due 1765561600)
lina_csm: On it.
sam_eng: Done — pushed slide note, added patch link: https://git.internal/commit/abc123
marie_cs: Got it, thanks.
aj_sales: Draft done, sharing: https://drive.redwood/qbr/atlaspay/renewal-points (comments welcome).
rafael_enable: Workshop outline added to slide deck.
lina_csm: Legal intro sent to legal@cust.com (threaded email).
marie_cs: Quick check — anything that should change the exec message?
sam_eng: Demo env still flaky for long interactive sessions; recommend using a recorded walkthrough clip instead of live demo.
aj_sales: Agreed — record it and add a short note on backup/demo fallback slide.
marie_cs: Dry-run agenda: 10:30am intro, 10:35 slide walk, 11:00 rehearse leadership asks & fallback.
reminder-bot: Dry-run reminder: 23h55m remaining.
lina_csm: Marking A1/A2/A3/A4 complete except legal response pending.
marie_cs: Thanks team — I'll compile the final deck at 8am day-of and post to the drive. :sparkles:
